endpoint_eligibility.graph_brier_and_auprc: eligible retrospectively only when all component predictions share a source-removed calibrated binary contract
endpoint_eligibility.graph_open_champion: ineligible because no sealed graph source exists
endpoint_eligibility.unified_endpoint_noninferiority: blocked until every specialist and endpoint-specific component roster is frozen
endpoint_eligibility.unified_open_champion: ineligible under the current blocked TaskSpec without the required eligible independent external source families

component_and_selection_protocol.calibration: Each component is calibrated inside its own training folds before fusion. Fusion fits no weight and never recalibrates on sealed or evaluated-source labels.
component_and_selection_protocol.family_roster: One selection-locked artifact per admitted component family and endpoint. Correlated seeds, checkpoints, or readouts from one family do not receive multiple votes unless a prespecified family-level average was already frozen.
component_and_selection_protocol.leakage_inheritance: Any component with donor, locus, source, assay, outcome, or checkpoint contamination invalidates that row's fusion. Averaging cannot wash out leakage.
component_and_selection_protocol.missingness: Average available admissible components and emit the availability pattern. No-component rows are structurally_missing. Report every pattern and denominator.
component_and_selection_protocol.same_endpoint_only: Do not average expression effects with accessibility, reporter activity, links, ranks, embeddings, disease scores, or predictions from another lineage or assay.
component_and_selection_protocol.selection: Freeze components before fusion and use only development-visible out-of-fold predictions. Sealed labels cannot choose components or family count.

current_coloc_gwas.allowed_use: Development-only graph or variant component predictions after corrected release promotion. Fusion does not receive COLOC membership directly unless that is the declared endpoint input.

gse281160.allowed_use: Development-only component evaluation and calibration within its registered task. Cells and guides are not independent rows for fusion fitting.
gse281160.warning: Its 20 MPRA-selected targets are not a sealed source.

gse281364.allowed_use: Development-only out-of-fold MPRA component predictions under locus and sequence grouping; not a signed eQTL calibration source.

gse289173.allowed_use: Only anonymized component predictions and masks after every variant or cell specialist and the fusion manifest are selection-locked. Labels and QTL outcomes remain evaluator-only.
gse289173.warning: It is a seal for eligible specialist endpoints, not a graph source seal.

gse267031.allowed_use: Only if its conditional bulk seal passes donor deduplication, endpoint completeness, and prospective power before outcomes are read. Otherwise no sealed fusion row is allowed.

fnih_86_liver.allowed_use: None unless an openly downloadable rights-cleared release is activated before selection lock. Do not delay development or infer eligibility from the publication.

resource_and_project_development.allowed_use: Only immutable out-of-fold component predictions from registered train/development roles. Frozen 117 programs and current Resource claims remain read-only and cannot be fusion features or selection endpoints.

graph_held_source_protocol.candidate_universe: Every component uses the identical source-independent row roster. Fusion cannot outer-join held-source-only candidates into existence.
graph_held_source_protocol.component_receipt: Bind the same held-source removal hash for every graph component. A component trained with the source is excluded rather than masked.
graph_held_source_protocol.degree_and_observability: Report component and fused performance within remaining-source degree, source-count, and observability strata. Held-source observability remains evaluator-only.
graph_held_source_protocol.removal: No component or fusion join may contain held-source nodes, edges, inverses, aliases, labels, tested status, coverage, missingness, graph statistics, prevalence, or deterministic derivatives.
graph_held_source_protocol.seal_status: No current graph source is sealed; clean construction does not create an external claim.

variant_gene_and_ld_contract.block_alignment: Component rows must share native-build LD block, locus, sequence identity group, variant, gene, and direction identities. A mismatched join fails rather than averaging across related variants.
variant_gene_and_ld_contract.gene_mapping: A link-only or nearest-gene prediction remains an unsigned retrieval component. It cannot supply a signed gene effect to a primary fusion endpoint.
variant_gene_and_ld_contract.no_duplicate_votes: Multiple variants in one LD block, related model seeds, or duplicate source releases cannot become independent fusion components or inferential units.
variant_gene_and_ld_contract.unit: Resample LD and gene blocks for graph endpoints and the TaskSpec's biological units for other endpoints.

reproducibility_contract.fusion_receipt: Hash ordered component IDs, family identities, RunSpecs, PredictionBundles, calibration artifacts, endpoint contracts, exact row joins, availability masks, arithmetic precision, outputs, and exclusions.
reproducibility_contract.zero_fit_rule: Equal weights are mathematical constants. Any optimized, stacked, gated, or source-specific weights define a different model and require a new audit.
